//: This is a BARE workflow: apps/mobile/ios/ is COMMITTED and AUTHORITATIVE.
The real native config is ios/cravesearch/Info.plist, cravesearch.entitlements,
PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and the Podfile. Everything under `expo.ios` below is
FOSSIL from before the eject -- it is read by prebuild and by nothing else, so
editing it changes NOTHING about what builds.
`expo prebuild` (and `--clean`, and anything that invokes it) REGENERATES ios/
from this file. This file describes a project with NO SearchMapRenderController
(13k lines, owner-locked), NO MapLodKit/TrackScrollKit pods, NO custom Podfile,
NO location/photo purpose strings and NO privacy manifest -- note `plugins` is
config plugins whose job is to inject those keys. Prebuild here is a ~15k-line
silent revert to a template, not a regeneration.
If you genuinely need prebuild back, that is a migration: express the custom
native code as local config plugins FIRST, then delete ios/ deliberately.
The guard that notices drift is scripts/mobile-native-authority-gate.sh (CI).
This `//` key is inert -- Expo reads only the `expo` object.

infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to connect to your local network for development
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera so you can add photos of your food
